title: Turns / Yr annualizes the sales rate, is 0.00 at zero stock, can be negative
refs: SV-8645 (PV spec v10 2026-08-17 S5-R4 (Turns / Yr); S5 Definitions (Window))
preconds:
1. The Turns / Yr column is enabled.
2. Part A: known Units Sold over a known window with On Hand > 0 (e.g. Units Sold 10.00 over a 30-day window with 5 on hand).
3. Part B: in-window sales but On Hand now 0.
4. Part C: negative Units Sold (reversals exceed sales) with stock on hand..
steps:
1. Compute the expected value for part A: (Units Sold ÷ Window days × 365) ÷ On Hand - e.g. (10 ÷ 30 × 365) ÷ 5 = 24.33.
2. Compare against the displayed Turns / Yr for part A.
3. Read Turns / Yr for parts B and C, and for any special-order row.
expected:
1. Part A's Turns / Yr matches the formula (two decimals, e.g. 24.33); the window is the whole-day span inclusive of both dates with a floor of 1 day.
2. Part B shows 0.00 (renders 0.00 when On Hand is 0 - not an error, not —).
3. Part C shows a NEGATIVE Turns / Yr with a leading minus (because Units Sold can be negative).
4. Special Order rows always show — (not applicable).

---
